errorCodes.meaning: The community has badges turned off (VTI-BDG-004). Nothing was recorded.
The badge is retired and is never given again (VTI-BDG-005).
The badge is a kudos badge. Kudos are given by any member with vtc/badges/kudos/give, not offered by an owner.
The badge is automatic — its badge group is dynamic — and is given by its rule, never by hand (VTI-BDG-013).
`group` names a group the signer may not see, or whose member list the signer may not see. Nothing was recorded.
Every recipient was skipped. The reasons are in `details.skipped`, shaped as the response's `skipped`.

Award.description: One giving of a badge to one member. `givenBy` is the giver's directory entry, absent for an award a dynamic badge group's rule made. `note` is shown to the recipient, the giver, the badge's owners and administrators, never to other members. `credentialId` is present on an accepted award of a community badge: the badge credential that evidences it, renewed or re-issued as the badge's regime requires. `shared` is present on an accepted award of a badge its holders may show outside while its holder shares it (vtc/badges/awards/share).

decidedAt.description: When the recipient accepted or declined, the giver withdrew, the offer expired, or the award was revoked.

expiresAt.description: When an unanswered offer lapses, where the community expires offers.

Award.title: Award

AwardId.description: Opaque identifier of one giving of a badge to one member: `awd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community.
AwardId.title: AwardId

AwardNote.description: What the award is for, from the giver, shown to the recipient and written as the award's evidence narrative where the badge carries a credential. Plain text; erased with its author (VTI-BDG-090).
AwardNote.title: AwardNote

AwardShare.description: Where an accepted award is shown outside the community, by its holder's choice (VTI-BDG-070): the public location that answers a verification of exactly what the credential says, the baked image where the community serves one, and since when. Present only while the holder shares the award; absent once they stop, the award is taken back, the badge is retired or the holder departs. The locations are unguessable and name no other holder (VTI-BDG-071).

bakedImageUrl.description: The badge's picture with the credential baked into it, for a website or an email signature. Absent where the community serves no baked image.

verificationUrl.description: The public location that answers the credential and a verification of it.

AwardShare.title: AwardShare

AwardState.description: `offered`: waiting for the recipient. `accepted`: the recipient took it; for a community badge the credential was issued and the membership recorded. `declined`: the recipient declined; nothing was recorded in the group and nothing issued. `withdrawn`: the giver withdrew the offer before a decision. `expired`: the offer lapsed unanswered. `revoked`: taken back after acceptance (VTI-BDG-023).
AwardState.title: AwardState

BadgeId.description: Opaque identifier of a badge: `bdg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BDG-001).
BadgeId.title: BadgeId

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupCredentialId.description: Identifier (`id`) of a group membership credential issued to a member. Each renewal issues a new credential with a new identifier. Validity is the community's setting; a community SHOULD default to 30 days, renewed when 10 days remain.
GroupCredentialId.title: GroupCredentialId

GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.
GroupId.title: GroupId

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/awards/offer/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/awards/offer/0.1#response.

awards.description: The offers recorded, each in state `offered`.

skipped.description: Members the badge was not offered to, and why. Never an error: the rest of the offers stand.

reason.description: `notActiveMember`: not an active member, or not one the signer may see. `alreadyOffered`: an open offer of this badge already names them. `alreadyHolder`: they hold the badge and it is not repeatable. `requestPending`: they have asked for the badge; the owners decide the request instead.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Awards — Offer — response payload

schema.description: A badge's owner offers a community badge to one or more members, or to every member of a group. Each offer is an award in state `offered` that the member accepts or declines; nothing is admitted or issued until they accept. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

group.description: Offer the badge to every active member of this group whose member list the signer may see. Exactly one of `to` and `group` is present.

note.description: What the award is for. Shown to each recipient and written as the award's evidence narrative on acceptance.

to.description: The members to offer the badge to. Exactly one of `to` and `group` is present.

schema.title: VTC Badges — Awards — Offer — payload
